verdictLabel: เลือกเป็นตัว
summary: S&P 500 closed ~7,504 on Jul 7 (~1.4% below the Jun 2 ATH of 7,609.78), still above the 50-day (~7,403) and 200-day (~6,948) moving averages, but momentum has stalled: geopolitics (US–Iran escalation) lifted crude and triggered a tech-led pullback (XLK −2.4% session read). VIX remains calm at 16.13 in contango (VIX3M 19.01), yet ticked +3.6% on the day — not panic, but no longer falling. Breadth is healthier than the Jun low (~67% of S&P names above 50DMA per Jul 7 read), while HY OAS stays historically tight at 2.72%. The Fed is on hold at 3.50–3.75% with a hawkish June dot plot; June CPI lands Jul 14 (6 days) before the Jul 28–29 FOMC + Mag-7 earnings stack. New cash: selective sizing OK through CPI, then pause additions into the late-July event cluster.
